items: KEBBI STATE (PSI 9.3): Gov. Idris Flags Off Over ₦8Bn Community Investment Fund Disbursement to 3,000+ Women Affinity Groups Across Kebbi
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 9.0): Launches Statewide Security Campaign with 1,000 Commands, Partners NEMSAS on Maternal Emergency Transport & Reviews Tertiary Salaries
RIVERS STATE (PSI 8.7): Commences New Wage Implementation for Polytechnic Lecturers to End ASUP Strike & Accelerates Ngo-Atlantic Oyorokoto Beach Road
OSUN STATE (PSI 8.5): State Executive Council Approves 2027 Draft Budget for Legislative Transmission & Ratifies New Owamiran of Esa-Oke
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.3): Gov. Mbah Rolls Out Earth-Moving Equipment to Commence 54km Nsukka–Adani Highway Reconstruction
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.0): Intensifies Statewide Diabetes Screening & PLASCHEMA Coverage, Distributes SURWASH Toilet Materials in Langtang North
LAGOS STATE (PSI 7.8): LASISMA Showcases Solar Kiosks, CNG Spaces & e-PPPS to FCTA Delegation, Trains Sanitation Workforce on Safety
KWARA STATE (PSI 7.6): Gov. AbdulRazaq Rewards Flamingos Coach & Defender with ₦10M and Houses Each, Announces ₦100M Team Incentive
KANO STATE (PSI 7.4): SSG Inaugurates Investigation Committee into Administration of Kano State College of Nursing Sciences
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.2): Gov. Yahaya Visits Cham & Dadiya Chiefdoms, Orders Immediate Environmental Assessment of Dadiya Gully Erosion
EDO STATE (PSI 7.0): First Lady's Office & Edo Police Command Launch Joint Tactical Sting Operations Against 'One Chance' Robberies & Night Harassment
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 6.7): Information Commissioner Cobham Cites Homeland Security Success to Back State Police Domestication
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 6.4): Government Delegation for 2026 Christian Pilgrimage to Israel & Jordan Holds Pre-Departure Coordination Meeting

KEBBI (PSI 9.3): Gov. Nasir Idris flagged off the disbursement of over ₦8 billion in Community Investment Funds (CIF) to more than 3,000 Women Affinity Groups under the World Bank-backed Nigeria for Women Programme Scale-Up Project in Birnin Kebbi, building on 83,000 mobilised women across 3,506 groups who have generated ₦4.11bn in savings and ₦1.31bn in internal loans.

ZAMFARA (PSI 9.0): Gov. Dauda Lawal's administration launched a statewide security campaign establishing up to 1,000 equipped local commands led by LGA chairmen, partnered with NEMSAS under SAVEMAMA RESMAT to expand rural maternal ambulance transport, inaugurated a committee to resolve tertiary institution salary structures, and initiated geological lab and utility vehicle upgrades in the Environment Ministry.

RIVERS (PSI 8.7): Gov. Siminalayi Fubara's administration commenced administrative and financial processes for a new polytechnic wage structure during talks led by SSG Dr. Dagogo Wokoma urging ASUP to suspend its strike, while Gov. Fubara inspected the Ngo-Atlantic Oyorokoto Beach Road in Andoni LGA ahead of December asphalting and tourism investor onboarding.

OSUN (PSI 8.5): Gov. Ademola Adeleke presided over the Osun State Executive Council to approve the 2027 Recurrent and Capital Draft Budget estimates for immediate transmission to the House of Assembly and ratified Prince Adewumi Olusola Adeniyi of Godo-dudu royal house as the new Owamiran of Esa-Oke.

ENUGU (PSI 8.3): Gov. Peter Mbah deployed earth-moving machinery to begin reconstructing the 54-kilometre Nsukka–Adani highway in Uzo-Uwani LGA, fulfilling a commitment made on November 10 during community engagements at Ogboli Development Centre.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.0): Health Commissioner Dr. Nicholas Ba’amlong launched expanded diabetes screening across 17 LGAs—following workplace screening of 1,000 civil servants—backed by PLASCHEMA free first-line medications and a planned Plateau Specialist Hospital renal dialysis centre, while PLAMWASSA distributed SURWASH toilet materials to 100 households in Langtang North.

LAGOS (PSI 7.8): LASISMA hosted a 7-man FCTA Development Control delegation led by Dr. Edward Tom to study Lagos' e-PPPS, urban agriculture, CNG spaces, and solar-powered kiosks, while the Office of Environmental Services trained sanitation workers at Alausa on PPE usage and occupational safety.

KWARA (PSI 7.6): Gov. AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq hosted Flamingos head coach Hakeem Busari and defender Yusuf Rodiat Kanyinsola in Ilorin following Nigeria's FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup triumph in Morocco, rewarding each with ₦10 million and a house alongside ₦100 million for the entire national team.

KANO (PSI 7.4): Kano SSG Alhaji Umar Farouk Ibrahim inaugurated an investigative panel chaired by Information Commissioner Alhaji Sanusi Bature Dawakin Tofa—including anti-corruption, health ministry, and nursing union representatives—to probe misconduct allegations against the Provost and management of the College of Nursing Sciences.

GOMBE (PSI 7.2): Gov. Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya visited the palaces of Nidu gra Cham and Folo Dadiya in Balanga LGA, highlighted 30% mobilisation payment for the 15km Bangunji–Dadiya–Yelwa–Gombe–Yola road alongside Cham Dam and Talasse power restoration, and ordered an immediate Ministry of Environment assessment of gully erosion in Dadiya.

EDO (PSI 7.0): Coordinator of the Office of the Edo First Lady Mrs. Edesili Okpebholo Anani and Commissioner of Police CP Patrick Daaor agreed on heightened residential night patrols, a dedicated police tactical sting unit against 'one chance' transit criminals, and expanded female operational representation in Benin City.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 6.7): Cross River Information Commissioner Pastor Ekpenyong Cobham backed state police domestication through the State House of Assembly, citing the non-partisan security gains recorded in Calabar South by the state's Homeland Security Services.

ADAMAWA (PSI 6.4): The Adamawa State Government Delegation for the 2026 Christian Pilgrimage to Israel and Jordan, chaired by HRM Johnson Diyo Matalo (Gubo Yungur), convened with the Christian Pilgrims Welfare Board to finalize welfare, safety, and travel logistics.
